updated.description: When the conversation last changed, in milliseconds.

context_team_id.description: The workspace the conversation was asked about from.

properties.description: Conversation settings such as its canvas (properties.canvas.file_id).

patches.why: Slack answers a conversation with `updated` (milliseconds), `context_team_id` and `properties` beside the fields the published schema lists: the example response of conversations.info carries all three (https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/conversations.info), and conversations.create's example carries `properties.canvas` (https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/conversations.create). The schema predates them.

value.description: The conversation's locale: conversations.info answers it when asked (include_locale), conversations.rename always.

patches.why: Slack answers a conversation's `locale` where the caller asks for it and on a rename: conversations.info's include_locale is "Set this to true to receive the locale for this conversation" (https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/conversations.info), and the spec's own conversations.rename example carries "locale": "en-US". The published schema omits the field.

value.description: Who last edited the message, and when.

patches.why: An edited message carries `edited: { user, ts }`: the message inside the message_changed event's example has it (https://docs.slack.dev/reference/events/message/message_changed); the published message schema omits it.
